investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-15T00:27–00:35Z because every pod submitted to the Kubernetes cluster was rejected as Unschedulable: the 2 nodes carrying the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource reported insufficient capacity, and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity or selector. No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected because the agent VM never started.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent swarm has exhausted the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource on the only 2 nodes that satisfy the pod's node affinity/selector. With 0 preemption victims available and 4 other nodes excluded by affinity rules, no new remote-agent pod can be scheduled. This is a cluster-infrastructure capacity constraint, not an application code defect. The eval failure is localized to the remote-agents feature in the production-api runtime environment; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so this is an observability eval failure rather than a confirmed user-facing outage.

investigations.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-08-15T00:30–00:35Z with an identical Kubernetes scheduler message: the production cluster's 6 nodes cannot place new kata peer-pod VMs because 2 nodes report Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes do not satisfy the pod's node affinity/selector. Because the agent pod never scheduled, the eval runner's createAgent call never returned an agent identity, leaving all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, readyState, state) unpopulated and causing the expected-output contract to fail completely.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster serving the production-api remote-agent workload has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the two nodes that match the pod's node affinity/selector. With 0 of 6 nodes available and preemption unable to free capacity, every eval attempt to provision a remote agent pod times out unscheduled (~143–149 s), preventing any agent lifecycle state from being reached and leaving the expected-output contract with zero evidence. This is an infrastructure capacity constraint, not an application code defect, and is localized to the remote-agents feature in the production-api environment. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence; impact is currently confirmed only at the eval layer.

The snapshot file is stale beyond the 300-minute contract threshold defined in infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json (line 482). This is an eval-detected pipeline staleness condition; no evidence of a user-facing web outage is present — all public page checks passed.
